proxy.title: Proxies
proxy.addFirstProxy: Connect your local services to the world. Add your first proxy configuration to get started.
proxy.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this proxy? This action cannot be undone.
proxy.pluginEnableDesc: Use a frp plugin to extend proxy functionality
proxy.transportEncryptionDesc: Enable to encrypt data during transport
proxy.dataCompressionDesc: Enable to compress data during transport
proxy.errorInvalidDomain: Invalid domain (no http://, port or path)
proxy.errorInvalidSubdomain: Subdomain may only contain letters, digits and hyphens
proxy.visitorServerNameDesc: Podux registers proxies on frps as "name-ID"; visitors on other machines must use this as the proxy name.
proxy.secretTypeHint: STCP, SUDP and XTCP proxies open no public port on frps; only visitors with the same secret key can connect. XTCP tries a direct peer-to-peer connection so traffic skips frps.
proxy.secretKeyDesc: Visitors must use the same key.
proxy.allowUsersPlaceholder: Empty = same user only, * = any user
proxy.allowUsersDesc: Comma separated; matches the user setting of the visitor's frpc.
proxy.healthCheckDesc: frpc checks the local service periodically, takes the proxy offline after repeated failures and brings it back when it recovers.
proxy.selectPage: Select all proxies on this page
proxy.batchDeleteConfirm: Delete the {{count}} selected proxies? This cannot be undone.
proxy.batchFailed: Batch failed; no proxy was changed
proxy.httpAuthDesc: When set, visitors of the domain must sign in with this username and password (HTTP Basic auth).
proxy.httpAuthTcpmuxDesc: When set, HTTP CONNECT requests must carry this username and password.
proxy.routeByHTTPUserDesc: Only take requests with this username, so proxies can share a domain and split by user.
proxy.hostHeaderRewriteDesc: Replaces the Host header sent to the local service, for services that route by host name.
proxy.locationsDesc: Only forward requests under these path prefixes, such as /api, so one domain can be split across proxies. Empty means all paths.
proxy.lbDesc: Proxies with the same group and key, possibly on different machines, share one port or domain and frps spreads connections across them; combine with health checks for failover.
proxy.pluginPemPlaceholder: Paste PEM content, or a file path on the Podux host
proxy.pluginPemDesc: Paste the certificate and key, which Podux writes to its data directory, or give paths on the Podux host (mount them in Docker). Leave both empty for a self-signed certificate.

pluginDesc.socks5: Turns the proxy into a SOCKS5 server for reaching the LAN.
pluginDesc.http_proxy: Turns the proxy into an HTTP proxy server for reaching the LAN.
pluginDesc.static_file: Publishes a local directory as a file download site.
pluginDesc.unix_domain_socket: Publishes a local Unix socket, such as the Docker API.
pluginDesc.http2http: Forwards HTTP to another local HTTP address, optionally rewriting Host and headers.
pluginDesc.http2https: Takes HTTP and forwards it to a local HTTPS service.
pluginDesc.https2http: Terminates HTTPS here with a certificate and forwards plain HTTP to the local service.
pluginDesc.https2https: Terminates HTTPS here and forwards HTTPS to the local service.
pluginDesc.tls2raw: Terminates TLS here and forwards plain TCP to the local service.

proxy.expiryDesc: When it expires the proxy is disabled and an alert is sent (if enabled); handy for exposing SSH or remote desktop for a while.
proxy.errorExpiry: Choose a time in the future

import.title: Import
import.description: Import servers and proxies from a FRP TOML config file
import.inputTomlDesc: Paste the content of your frpc.toml file, or upload it directly. Supports standard FRP v1 client configuration format.
import.tomlPlaceholder:
# frpc.toml
serverAddr = "x.x.x.x"
serverPort = 7000

[auth]
method = "token"
token = "your-token"

[[proxies]]
name = "ssh"
type = "tcp"
localIP = "127.0.0.1"
localPort = 22
remotePort = 6000
import.errorParseFailed: Failed to parse TOML content. Please check the format.
import.serverDuplicateWarning: A server with this address and port already exists. You can overwrite it or keep the existing one and only import proxies.
import.noProxies: No proxies found in this config file.
import.successDesc: Your servers and proxies have been imported.

warnings.tls_file_path_ignored: The TLS certificate, key or CA in this file are file paths. Podux stores certificate contents, not paths, so they were not imported. After importing, open the server's edit form and paste the certificate, key and CA contents.
warnings.unsupported_proxy_skipped: This file contains proxy types Podux doesn't support (such as TCPMUX); those proxies are not imported.
warnings.unsupported_visitor_skipped: This file contains visitors with a missing or unsupported type (only STCP, SUDP and XTCP); those visitors are not imported.

import.overwriteVisitors: Overwrite visitors with the same name

error.backendUnavailableDesc: The system status could not be checked. Make sure the service is running, then try again.

error.setupFailed: Failed to initialize system. Please try again.

visitor.title: Visitors
visitor.description: Listen on a local port to reach STCP, SUDP and XTCP proxies of other frpc clients
visitor.explain: A visitor runs on this machine: connect to its local address and port to reach an STCP/SUDP/XTCP proxy that another machine published with the same key, without a public port on frps.
visitor.emptyDescription: Add a visitor to reach STCP/XTCP proxies on other machines through a local port.
visitor.deleteConfirmMessage: Delete this visitor? This cannot be undone.
visitor.updateStatusFailed: Failed to update the visitor status
visitor.formDescription: Choose the proxy to reach and the local port to listen on
visitor.serverDesc: The visitor reaches the target through this server's frps, which must be the same frps the target proxy uses.
visitor.fillFromProxyDesc: If the target proxy is also managed by Podux, picking it fills in the server, type, name and key.
visitor.serverNameDesc: The target proxy's name on frps. Proxies managed by Podux are named "name-ID"; copy it from the proxy list.
visitor.serverUserDesc: The user setting of the target proxy's frpc; leave empty if it matches this server.
visitor.secretKeyDesc: The same key the target proxy uses.
visitor.bindDesc: Connect to this address and port to reach the target. 127.0.0.1 is local only; 0.0.0.0 allows the LAN.
visitor.keepTunnelOpenDesc: Set up the peer-to-peer tunnel in advance so the first connection is faster.
visitor.transportMatch: Encryption and compression must match the target proxy.
visitor.noBindDesc: Only used as an XTCP visitor's fallback.
visitor.fallbackDesc: When the peer-to-peer connection fails or times out, use the chosen STCP visitor instead (relayed by frps). It must be an STCP visitor of the same server for the same proxy, usually set to not listen.

export.title: Export frpc.toml
export.description: Export this server's configuration, with its enabled proxies and visitors, for use with native frpc.
export.includeSecrets: Include tokens, keys and other secrets
export.secretsWarning: The file will contain secrets in plain text. Keep it safe and don't share it publicly.

notifications.title: Alerts
notifications.description: Get notified when a server or proxy has a problem, and again when it recovers.

event.serverUnreachableDesc: frps fails 3 latency probes in a row
event.highLatencyDesc: Latency exceeds the threshold in 3 probes in a row
event.proxyDownDesc: An enabled proxy is offline for over 15 seconds; proxies of one server are grouped
event.frpcExitedDesc: frpc stops without you stopping it, e.g. its first login to frps failed
event.recoveredDesc: Notify again when a problem above clears
event.proxyUnreachableDesc: Online in frpc but failing 3 external probes in a row (about 3 minutes); TCP, HTTP and HTTPS proxies only
event.proxyExpiredDesc: A proxy with an expiry time was disabled

notifications.webhookDesc: A bot URL or any endpoint that accepts JSON. For DingTalk, use the custom keyword security setting with the keyword Podux.
notifications.telegramApiBaseDesc: Empty uses https://api.telegram.org; set a reverse proxy if it is not reachable.
notifications.emailDesc: Comma separated. Sent through the Mail settings configured in the PocketBase admin UI (/_/).
notifications.noChannels: Turn on at least one channel first

traffic.title: Traffic of "{{name}}", last 7 days
traffic.description: From the frps dashboard; frps resets it when it restarts.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: Backs up the whole data directory (database, certificates, logs). Restoring replaces all current data and restarts Podux.
backup.scheduleDesc: Runs in the server's time zone and keeps only the latest automatic backups; manual backups are never removed automatically.
backup.restoreConfirm: Replace all current data with {{name}}? Current data is lost (back it up first). Podux stops all tunnels, restarts, and you will need to sign in again.
backup.restoreTimeout: Podux didn't come back in time; check the container or service logs
